purpose: Resolve MRCS-13 authored definition references to existing MIB-14 owner definitions without duplicate definitions, inferred compatibility or live mutation.

package_kind_decision.reasoning: MRCS-13 packageKind remains an authoring category; the typed ownerReference selects the exact MIB-14 record and MIB-14 owns vehicle/platform/base/mecha/ship operational kind.

resolution_rules: Exact record type + stable ID + version must resolve to exactly one existing MIB-14 definition.
Existing stable ID with unmatched version fails owner-reference-version-not-found.
Source-unresolved semantics remain unresolved even if the MIB-14 owner reference exists.
GM-adjudication-required semantics do not become operationally resolved automatically.
Modular components require explicit versioned MRCS compatibility evidence.
MRCS compatibility evidence is preserved but cannot override MIB-14 operational compatibility validation.
No synthetic MIB-14 definition or live Asset mutation is created by the bridge.

visible_representation_gaps.fact: MRCS-13 can preserve explicit slotReferences while MIB-14 currently operationalizes aggregate slotCapacity/slotCost and tag-based compatibility rather than first-class typed slot identity references.
visible_representation_gaps.carry_forward: OARC-03 normalization must keep the source slot reference; OARC-04 may determine whether a source-backed owner hook is required for gameplay specialization.

visible_representation_gaps.concern: component identity inside authored modular definitions
visible_representation_gaps.fact: MRCS-13 can preserve componentReferences while MIB-14 module/facility definitions do not currently expose a first-class componentReferences field.
visible_representation_gaps.carry_forward: OARC-03 normalization must preserve provenance and explicit component references; LSS/MERA ownership remains unchanged.
